title: Student use cases
subtitle: Academic Risk Platform · UML use-case view of proposed behaviour
description: The Student actor participates in four use cases inside the Academic Risk Platform boundary: voluntarily enter an observation after an information notice, view own history, inspect an eligible estimate and explanation or an unavailable state, and request export or deletion. Associations indicate participation, not data flow. Authentication is a required design control, not an implemented capability.

nodes.title: UC-01  Enter an observation
body: Read the purpose and voluntary-use notice

nodes.title: UC-02  View own history
body: Identify empty history or missing entries

nodes.title: UC-03  Inspect result and explanation
body: View an eligible estimate and available explanation

nodes.title: UC-04  Request export or deletion
body: Request a defined scope for personal records
Track actual status; acceptance is not completion
Solid associations show participation, not data-flow direction.
Authentication and ownership checks are required; their implementation is not asserted.
Deployment operations are outside these student use cases.

footer: Conceptual design · Use-case identifiers match the requirements and architecture documents
